verdict.rationale: Segment documents official libraries spanning web (Javascript), mobile (Kotlin Android, Swift) and server (C#, Java), shows an analytics.track call, and publishes the Segment Spec that applies across all its libraries and APIs. However, the evidence only demonstrates track; identify and page calls are never shown or described, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of identify and page calls in the Spec, per-SDK docs confirming the spec methods, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)

citations.quote: The Segment Spec provides guidance on meaningful data to capture, and the best format for it, across all of Segment's libraries and APIs.
